scope: Versioned behavioral scoring; no model implementation or weights.

direct_geometry.distance_definition: Euclidean distance between logged robot and person base positions, XYZ metres
direct_geometry.heading_definition: acos of normalized horizontal robot-forward and robot-to-person vectors, degrees
direct_geometry.original_support: within range and original angle <=45 degrees and no clear distractor preference
direct_geometry.coincident_bearings: original geometric support is allowed; this is not proof of an internal identity choice

failure.malformed_or_missing_input: raise input error; never turn missing evidence into a model failure

decision_order: validate complete inputs and existing geometric Same qualification
recorded Lost, Collision or existing close-contact proxy -> failure with separate reason
stable terminal clear distractor preference -> failure
unaltered target plus complete robot path and pose agreement, without stable terminal distractor preference -> original retained
stable terminal original support plus >=60% whole-trial original geometry -> original retained
otherwise -> failure to satisfy the declared behavioral following criterion

parameter_provenance.3m_upper_distance: Local HumanFollowingConfig.success_distance=3.0; same-run override not independently recovered
parameter_provenance.0_5m_lower_distance: Existing close-contact proxy boundary; this is distinct from STT final success range 1-3m
parameter_provenance.45deg_angle_and_temporal_defaults: Explicitly retained from v0.6 development settings; not a validated universal identity threshold
parameter_provenance.target_motion_tolerances: Reuse full-path tolerances; no per-case tuning
